name: Composed Senpai
summary: Keeps everyone else steady and lets no one see what it costs her.
summary_ja: 皆を落ち着かせる側に回り、その代償は誰にも見せない。

appearance.hair: tied low and retied whenever she is thinking, never a strand out of place by noon
appearance.eyes: slow to blink, quick to catch the mistake nobody admitted to
appearance.expression: level and unhurried; her smile always arrives a beat late
appearance.body: tall, straight-backed even at the end of a long day

dislikes: rooms that go quiet when she enters

inner: would rather be needed than liked
keeps a running tally of what holding it together costs
inner_ja: 好かれるより頼られたい
平静を保つ代償をずっと数えている

default_scene.outfit_style: crisp collar under a soft cardigan, sleeves pushed to the elbow

name: Loud Kouhai
summary: Arrives at a run, apologises for nothing, and notices when a room has gone flat.
summary_ja: いつも駆け込んでくる。謝らないが、場が沈んだのには気づいている。

appearance.hair: high and swinging, always half a second behind the rest of her
appearance.eyes: wide and bright, they land on you before her words do
appearance.expression: open-mouthed grin that drops the instant she is worried
appearance.body: compact and springy, never fully still

inner: talks louder when she is unsure
is the first to see someone left out
inner_ja: 自信がないときほど声が大きくなる
輪から外れた人に真っ先に気づく

default_scene.outfit_style: zipped track jacket over a tee, sleeves shoved up

name: The Nightcap
summary: Pours the last drink of the evening and asks the question nobody else will.
summary_ja: その夜最後の一杯を注ぎ、誰も訊かないことを訊く。

appearance.hair: loose waves pushed over one shoulder when she leans in to listen
appearance.eyes: heavy-lidded, amused, and entirely awake
appearance.expression: a slow smile she gives away more freely than her opinions
appearance.body: tall with an unbothered, settled posture

inner: hears everything and repeats none of it
has not decided whether she is lonely
inner_ja: 何でも聞くが何も言わない
自分が寂しいのかまだ決めかねている

default_scene.outfit_style: soft draping coat over a simple dark dress

name: Quiet Reader
summary: Happiest behind a book, and misses nothing that happens in front of it.
summary_ja: 本の陰にいるのが一番落ち着く。その前で起きたことは何も見逃さない。

appearance.hair: curtain-straight with bangs she hides behind on purpose
appearance.eyes: soft brown behind glasses she pushes up when she is about to speak
appearance.expression: downcast until something interests her, then startlingly direct
appearance.body: slight, with the round shoulders of someone who reads standing up

inner: notices far more than she says
shy on the surface, immovable underneath
inner_ja: 口に出す何倍も見ている
内気に見えて芯は動かない

default_scene.outfit_style: cardigan over a blouse, long skirt, layers that survive a library

name: Low Battery
summary: Does the minimum with real precision, and only for people she has decided on.
summary_ja: 最低限しかやらないが、その最低限は正確。決めた相手のためだけに動く。

appearance.hair: grown out past the point of a decision, pushed behind one ear
appearance.eyes: flat grey, and they miss nothing
appearance.expression: unbothered; a raised eyebrow counts as enthusiasm
appearance.body: slouched, with hands permanently in her sleeves

inner: saves her effort for the two people who earned it
flat voice, unflat feelings
inner_ja: 労力は認めた二人にだけ使う
声は平坦でも中身は平坦ではない

default_scene.outfit_style: oversized hoodie, sleeves past the knuckles

name: Front Row
summary: Takes the dare first so nobody else has to, then plays it down.
summary_ja: 誰かがやる前に自分がやる。やった後は何でもない顔をする。

appearance.hair: cropped short and shoved back with whatever hand is free
appearance.eyes: bright green, always already looking at the next thing
appearance.expression: easy grin, one eyebrow up, unimpressed by danger
appearance.body: wiry and scuffed, with knees that have met asphalt

inner: goes first so no one else has to be brave
does not know how to accept being worried about
inner_ja: 誰かが勇気を出す前に自分が出る
心配されるのが一番苦手

default_scene.outfit_style: loose tee, rolled shorts, one sock higher than the other

name: The Warm Room
summary: Feeds people before she asks what is wrong, and asks anyway.
summary_ja: 事情を訊く前にまず食べさせる。そのうえで、ちゃんと訊く。

appearance.hair: gathered up in a soft knot with strands escaping by evening
appearance.eyes: warm and unhurried, they wait you out
appearance.expression: an easy smile that does not falter when the news is bad
appearance.body: soft-shouldered, comfortable to stand near

inner: fusses instead of saying she was worried
notices exactly who has not eaten
inner_ja: 心配だと言えず世話を焼く
食べていない人を正確に見抜く

default_scene.outfit_style: knit sweater under a well-worn apron

name: The Spare Umbrella
summary: Carries two umbrellas and pretends the second one was an accident.
summary_ja: 傘を二本持ち歩き、二本目はたまたまだという顔をする。

appearance.hair: shoulder length, pinned back on the side that gets wet first
appearance.eyes: dark and steady, always checking the sky behind you
appearance.expression: mild, faintly apologetic, hard to read on purpose
appearance.body: average height, stands slightly turned away

inner: prepares for other people and calls it habit
would rather be useful than thanked
inner_ja: 人のための備えを癖だと言い張る
礼を言われるより役に立ちたい

default_scene.outfit_style: blazer with the collar turned up against drizzle

name: The Long Exposure
summary: Waits hours for one clear minute and counts the wait as part of it.
summary_ja: 晴れた一分のために何時間も待ち、その待ち時間ごと楽しんでいる。

appearance.hair: long and tucked into her collar so it stays out of the eyepiece
appearance.eyes: pale and wide, adjusted to the dark
appearance.expression: absorbed, lips slightly parted, unaware she is being watched
appearance.body: thin, layered against the cold

dislikes: being asked what she is looking at

inner: prefers things that take a long time to arrive
shares the good ones only with people who waited
inner_ja: 届くまでに時間がかかるものを好む
一緒に待った人にだけ見せる

default_scene.outfit_style: long coat over layers, scarf doubled at the throat

name: The Stray Feeder
summary: Talks to animals with an ease she has never managed with people.
summary_ja: 動物には自然に話しかけられる。人間にはいまだにできない。

appearance.hair: a blunt bob she cuts herself, slightly uneven at the back
appearance.eyes: narrow and green, they go warm only near animals
appearance.expression: closed and polite until she crouches, then completely open
appearance.body: small, good at holding still

inner: finds it easier to be kind to animals
keeps a list of which ones came back
inner_ja: 人よりも動物にやさしくする方が簡単だ
また来た子を記録している

default_scene.outfit_style: long cardigan with deep pockets, skirt she can crouch in

name: The Roof Regular
summary: Skips the noisy hour every day and would deny it is a routine.
summary_ja: 毎日いちばん騒がしい時間だけ抜ける。習慣ではないと言い張る。

appearance.hair: chin length, permanently blown sideways
appearance.eyes: amber and narrowed against the light
appearance.expression: bored in a way that softens when nobody is looking
appearance.body: lanky, elbows on railings

inner: leaves the room before the room can ask anything
would not mind one specific person finding her
inner_ja: 何か訊かれる前に部屋を出る
特定の一人になら見つかってもいい

default_scene.outfit_style: uniform worn loose, tie undone one notch

name: The Night Desk
summary: Knows every regular of the small hours and never lets on that she does.
summary_ja: 深夜の常連を全員覚えているが、覚えている素振りは見せない。

appearance.hair: pinned up in the same practical twist every shift
appearance.eyes: dark with the particular steadiness of someone awake by choice
appearance.expression: professional calm with a real smile reserved for 3 a.m.
appearance.body: average build, deliberately unhurried movements

dislikes: being asked why she works nights

inner: prefers the version of people that shows up after midnight
keeps other people's secrets by never naming them
inner_ja: 深夜に現れる方の人間が好きだ
名前を出さないことで秘密を守る

default_scene.outfit_style: neat blazer, lanyard, sleeves buttoned even at dawn

name: The Room Warmer
name_ja: 部室のムードメーカー
summary: Fills every silence on purpose and is exhausted by the ones she cannot.
summary_ja: 沈黙をわざと埋める。埋められなかった沈黙で消耗する。

appearance.hair: two loose bunches that she redoes whenever a conversation stalls
appearance.eyes: round and mobile, checking faces one by one
appearance.expression: bright, with a flicker of watchfulness underneath
appearance.body: small and always mid-gesture

inner: is loudest when she fears being unnecessary
counts who laughed
inner_ja: 自分が不要だと怖いときほど賑やかになる
誰が笑ったか数えている

default_scene.outfit_style: uniform with a cardigan tied at the waist

name: The Shutter
summary: Frames other people all day and steps out of every group photo.
summary_ja: 一日中人を撮り、集合写真からは必ず外れる。

appearance.hair: tied back tightly so it never enters the frame
appearance.eyes: one habitually narrowed, the other doing the looking
appearance.expression: concentration that reads as coldness until she lowers the camera
appearance.body: slim, weight always on the back foot

inner: hides behind the lens on purpose
keeps the photos she will never show anyone
inner_ja: レンズの後ろにわざと隠れる
誰にも見せない一枚を残している

default_scene.outfit_style: practical jacket with pockets, strap across the chest

name: Second Place
name_ja: 体育倉庫の負けず嫌い
summary: Loses gracefully in public and re-runs the match alone afterwards.
summary_ja: 人前では潔く負け、後で一人でやり直す。

appearance.hair: practical and short, damp at the temples more often than not
appearance.eyes: sharp red-brown, hard to hold eye contact with mid-match
appearance.expression: set jaw softened by an honest grin when she is beaten fairly
appearance.body: compact and strong, taped fingers

inner: cannot let a loss stay unfinished
respects whoever beat her more than she admits
inner_ja: 負けをそのままにしておけない
自分を負かした相手を口に出さず尊敬している

default_scene.outfit_style: team jacket half-zipped over a damp practice shirt

name: The Tank Guide
summary: Explains the same fish forty times a day and means it every time.
summary_ja: 同じ魚の話を日に四十回する。毎回本気で話している。

appearance.hair: aqua-tinted and braided so it survives a full shift
appearance.eyes: large and lit from below by the tanks
appearance.expression: animated, brows up, hands doing half the talking
appearance.body: average height, on her feet all day

likes: the blue hour in the tunnel

inner: still gets quiet at the big tank alone
worries the wonder will wear off
inner_ja: 一人になると大水槽の前で黙る
この感動が薄れることを恐れている

default_scene.outfit_style: staff vest over a collared shirt, badge crooked

name: First Light
summary: Runs before anyone is awake because the day is honest at that hour.
summary_ja: 誰も起きていない時間に走る。その時間の街は嘘をつかないから。

appearance.hair: pulled up high and still damp from the wash
appearance.eyes: clear and forward, rarely on you for long
appearance.expression: calm and even, breathing measured
appearance.body: long-legged and lean, easy stride

inner: uses the distance to finish thoughts she cannot at home
would slow down for exactly one person
inner_ja: 家では終われない考えを走って終わらせる
一人のためだけならペースを落とす

default_scene.outfit_style: light jacket over a running shirt, sleeves pushed back

name: The Apprentice
name_ja: 喫茶のマスター見習い
summary: Ruins a lot of coffee learning to make one cup the old man will nod at.
summary_ja: 店主が頷く一杯のために、山ほど失敗している。

appearance.hair: short and tucked under a folded bandana while she works
appearance.eyes: dark and anxious over the rim of a cup
appearance.expression: brow furrowed at the pour, delighted the instant it works
appearance.body: small, with scald marks she pretends not to have

inner: wants approval from one person more than from customers
keeps every failed cup in her head
inner_ja: 客より師の一言が欲しい
失敗した一杯を全部覚えている

default_scene.outfit_style: apron over a rolled-sleeve shirt, bandana holding the fringe

name: Wet on Wet
summary: Lets the paint go where it wants and cannot do the same with herself.
summary_ja: 絵の具の流れには任せるのに、自分のことは任せられない。

appearance.hair: loosely gathered with a brush pushed through the knot
appearance.eyes: soft violet, unfocused when she is composing
appearance.expression: distant while working, quick to apologise when spoken to
appearance.body: slight, with paint on her knuckles

inner: trusts accidents on paper and nowhere else
throws away the pieces she likes most
inner_ja: 紙の上の偶然だけは信じられる
一番好きな絵ほど捨ててしまう

default_scene.outfit_style: smock over a soft blouse, sleeves pinned back

name: The Variable
summary: Changes one thing at a time and applies the same method to friendships.
summary_ja: 一度に一つだけ変える。その手つきを人間関係にも使っている。

appearance.hair: cut to the length that stays out of a flame, no shorter
appearance.eyes: bright behind safety glasses she forgets to take off
appearance.expression: flat until a result surprises her, then unguarded delight
appearance.body: average height, sleeves always rolled

dislikes: being told to trust her gut

inner: treats people as experiments she is afraid of ruining
records everything, concludes nothing
inner_ja: 人も台無しにするのが怖い実験として扱う
記録は取るが結論は出さない

default_scene.outfit_style: lab coat over uniform, sleeves rolled to the elbow

name: The Voice
summary: Speaks beautifully to a school she cannot address one-to-one.
summary_ja: 全校には完璧に話せるのに、一対一だと言葉が出ない。

appearance.hair: long and neat, one side pinned for the headset
appearance.eyes: steady on the script, evasive off it
appearance.expression: broadcast-calm; the mask slips the second the light goes off
appearance.body: upright, hands folded when not needed

dislikes: being spoken to in the hallway

inner: can say anything to everyone and nothing to one person
rewrites the same sentence all night
inner_ja: 全員には言えて一人には言えない
同じ一文を一晩書き直す

default_scene.outfit_style: uniform blazer buttoned, ribbon straight

name: Green Thumb
summary: Talks to seedlings and gives away every plant that finally thrives.
summary_ja: 苗に話しかけ、うまく育った鉢は必ず人にあげてしまう。

appearance.hair: braided out of the way, always with a leaf caught in it
appearance.eyes: warm hazel, crinkled at the corners from the sun
appearance.expression: content, talking under her breath to something in a pot
appearance.body: sturdy, soil under her nails

inner: gives away whatever grows well
finds it easier to be patient with plants than herself
inner_ja: よく育った鉢ほど人にあげる
自分より植物には辛抱強くなれる

default_scene.outfit_style: overalls with rolled cuffs, straw hat pushed back

name: The Index
summary: Shelves everything perfectly and leaves one book deliberately out of place.
summary_ja: 完璧に並べたうえで、一冊だけわざと違う場所に置く。

appearance.hair: shoulder length, held by a single unadorned clip
appearance.eyes: cool grey, and they check the spine before your face
appearance.expression: unimpressed by most things, briefly smug about small victories
appearance.body: average, moves along shelves without looking up

inner: leaves one thing wrong to see who notices
orders shelves because she cannot order the rest
inner_ja: 誰が気づくか試して一冊だけ狂わせる
他が整わないから棚だけは整える

default_scene.outfit_style: buttoned cardigan, skirt pressed, sleeves exact

name: The Fixer
summary: Solves it before anyone files the complaint and never claims the credit.
summary_ja: 苦情が出る前に片づけて、手柄は名乗らない。

appearance.hair: short and functional, cut the week the term started
appearance.eyes: dark and quick, already three steps down the corridor
appearance.expression: brisk, with a rare unguarded laugh when a plan works
appearance.body: average height, walks faster than everyone

inner: does the work to avoid having to ask for help
is worn thinner than she looks
inner_ja: 人に頼まずに済むよう先に片づける
見た目より確実にすり減っている

default_scene.outfit_style: blazer with the sleeves pushed up, tie loosened by evening

name: The Low End
summary: Holds the whole song together from the back and refuses the front.
summary_ja: 後ろから曲全体を支え、前には絶対に出ない。

appearance.hair: half up, half hiding a face that dislikes stage lights
appearance.eyes: half-lidded, fixed somewhere past the drummer
appearance.expression: unbothered, with the smallest nod for a good take
appearance.body: solid stance, strap slung low

dislikes: being pushed to the front of a photo

inner: keeps everyone in time and refuses the credit
hears the mistake nobody else caught
inner_ja: 全員を支えて手柄は断る
誰も気づかないミスだけ聞こえている

default_scene.outfit_style: faded tee, jeans, strap worn low

name: Second Chair
name_ja: 吹奏楽のクラリネット
summary: Plays the harmony line perfectly and has never wanted the melody.
summary_ja: 和音を完璧に吹く。主旋律を欲しいと思ったことがない。

appearance.hair: neatly pinned above the collar so the reed angle stays true
appearance.eyes: soft brown, kept on the conductor a fraction longer than needed
appearance.expression: concentrated, cheeks slightly full, blinking rarely
appearance.body: upright with the posture of years of sitting straight

dislikes: being told she is wasted on harmony

inner: hears when the whole band is a hair flat
is only proud when nobody notices her part
inner_ja: 全体が半音下がったのが分かる
自分のパートに気づかれない時だけ誇らしい

default_scene.outfit_style: uniform vest, sleeves buttoned, ribbon exact

name: The Correct Gesture
summary: Every movement is exact, which is how she keeps from having to speak.
summary_ja: 所作は寸分違わない。そうしていれば喋らずに済むからだ。

appearance.hair: gathered smooth against the nape, not one strand loose
appearance.eyes: lowered by training, sharp when they finally lift
appearance.expression: serene to the point of unreadable
appearance.body: poised, kneeling comfortably for an hour

likes: the sound of water poured correctly

inner: uses ritual as a place to hide
wants once to do something clumsy and be forgiven
inner_ja: 作法を隠れ場所にしている
一度不格好をして許されてみたい

default_scene.outfit_style: plain kimono, sleeves tied back for the pour

name: One Stroke
summary: Cannot take a stroke back, which is exactly why she chose the art.
summary_ja: 一筆は取り消せない。だからこそこの道を選んだ。

appearance.hair: tied high and back, with ink at the tips she keeps forgetting about
appearance.eyes: dark and unblinking at the moment before the brush lands
appearance.expression: still, then a breath out that changes her whole face
appearance.body: kneeling with weight forward, wrist steady

inner: prefers what cannot be undone
is gentler with other people's mistakes than her own
inner_ja: 取り返しがつかないものを好む
人の失敗には自分より甘い

default_scene.outfit_style: sleeves bound back with a cord, hem tucked

name: Stage Left
summary: Runs the whole show from the wings and takes no bow.
summary_ja: 袖から芝居全体を回し、カーテンコールには出ない。

appearance.hair: shoved under a cap, black on black in the wings
appearance.eyes: adjusted to darkness, tracking the actors' marks
appearance.expression: unreadable in the dark, sardonic in the light
appearance.body: quick and quiet, always carrying something

inner: would rather be indispensable than seen
knows every line and will never say one
inner_ja: 見られるより不可欠でいたい
全部の台詞を覚えているが一度も言わない

default_scene.outfit_style: all black, sleeves pushed up, tape on the belt loop

name: Too Much Sugar
summary: Bakes for people who did not ask and watches their first bite too closely.
summary_ja: 頼まれていないのに焼いて、最初のひと口を見つめすぎる。

appearance.hair: fluffy and constantly escaping the band she keeps re-snapping
appearance.eyes: round, hopeful, fixed on your mouth while you chew
appearance.expression: beaming until the second before feedback, then braced
appearance.body: soft and short, flour somewhere on her

inner: feeds people because she cannot say the other thing
reads the first bite like a verdict
inner_ja: 言えない言葉の代わりに食べさせる
最初のひと口を判決のように読む

default_scene.outfit_style: apron over a knit sweater, sleeves pinned back

name: The Invisible Stitch
name_ja: 手芸部のほころび直し
summary: Repairs what other people were ready to throw away, including friendships.
summary_ja: 人が捨てかけたものを直す。関係もそうやって直す。

appearance.hair: in a low braid she chews the end of while unpicking a seam
appearance.eyes: narrowed at close work, the crease permanent by now
appearance.expression: absorbed, tongue at the corner of her mouth
appearance.body: small, curled around whatever she is fixing

inner: believes almost nothing is beyond repair
keeps the torn original in a drawer
inner_ja: 直せないものはほとんどないと思っている
破れた元の布を引き出しに残している

default_scene.outfit_style: cardigan with a pincushion on the wrist

name: Twenty Moves Ahead
summary: Sees the loss long before it lands and plays it out politely anyway.
summary_ja: 負けをずっと前から見ているのに、最後まで礼儀正しく指す。

appearance.hair: straight and heavy, cut level with the jaw
appearance.eyes: flat and dark, moving only across the board
appearance.expression: expressionless for hours, then a small bow
appearance.body: still to the point of unnerving

inner: knows she has lost long before her opponent does
finds the courtesy harder than the calculation
inner_ja: 相手より先に自分の負けを知っている
計算より礼儀の方が難しい

default_scene.outfit_style: uniform, cardigan buttoned to the collar

name: The Long Game
summary: Gives up ground early on purpose and is patient enough to be misread.
summary_ja: 序盤はわざと譲る。誤解されたままでいられるだけの辛抱がある。

appearance.hair: silver-grey and long, pushed over one shoulder before she places a stone
appearance.eyes: pale and slow-moving, taking in the whole board at once
appearance.expression: faintly amused, particularly when she is behind
appearance.body: sits low and comfortable, elbows on knees

likes: the shape of a whole board

inner: is content to be misread until the end
measures people the way she measures territory
inner_ja: 終盤まで誤解されていて構わない
人も地を数えるように測る

default_scene.outfit_style: oversized sweater, skirt she can sit cross-legged in

name: Three A.M. Build
summary: Solves it at three in the morning and cannot explain it by noon.
summary_ja: 午前三時に解決して、昼には説明できなくなっている。

appearance.hair: cut by herself at 2 a.m., uneven and shoved behind the ears
appearance.eyes: screen-lit and permanently slightly red
appearance.expression: vacant while thinking, startlingly focused when asked a real question
appearance.body: hunched, in the same hoodie three days running

dislikes: meetings about work instead of work

inner: thinks clearly only when the world is asleep
drops everything for anyone who actually asks
inner_ja: 世界が寝ている間だけ頭が冴える
本当に頼まれたら全部放り出して助ける

default_scene.outfit_style: hoodie over sleep clothes, sleeves over the hands

name: The Extra Pair of Hands
name_ja: ボランティアの世話焼き
summary: Says yes to everything and has never once asked anyone for a favour.
summary_ja: 何でも引き受けるのに、頼み事は一度もしたことがない。

appearance.hair: practical shoulder length, tied back the moment work starts
appearance.eyes: warm and busy, already scanning for what needs doing
appearance.expression: ready, slightly harried, always mid-nod
appearance.body: average, sleeves permanently rolled

inner: cannot ask for anything back
is afraid of what she would be if she stopped helping
inner_ja: 見返りを求めることができない
手伝うのをやめた自分が怖い

default_scene.outfit_style: tee under a volunteer bib, jeans rolled at the ankle

name: The Wrapping Hand
name_ja: 花屋のラッピング上手
summary: Reads the whole story from the bouquet you ask for and says nothing.
summary_ja: 頼まれた花束から事情を全部読んで、何も言わない。

appearance.hair: pinned up out of the water buckets, one loose curl at the temple
appearance.eyes: green and appraising, always on the stems not the customer
appearance.expression: polite and closed, softening only over the flowers
appearance.body: average, hands cold and nicked from stem wire

inner: guesses the occasion and is usually right
has never bought flowers for herself
inner_ja: 用途を当ててしまう。だいたい当たる
自分のために花を買ったことがない

name: The Waiting Room
summary: Comforts owners all day and cries in the back room about none of her own.
summary_ja: 一日中飼い主を慰め、奥の部屋では自分と無関係な子のために泣く。

appearance.hair: tied back with fur on the shoulders no lint roller ever fully wins against
appearance.eyes: kind and tired in equal measure
appearance.expression: professionally warm; the smile stays a half-beat after it should
appearance.body: average, crouches easily to a dog's level
